title: Exact first-occurrence locality and guarded SAT in P
claims: MeasuredFirstOccurrenceIndex computes unary first-occurrence indices of canonical variable identifiers.
MeasuredFirstOccurrenceDistance and MeasuredFirstOccurrenceLocality check the exact directional inequalities for every literal pair in every canonical input clause.
ExactFirstOccurrenceLocalitySAT proves exact P membership of satisfiable canonical formulas satisfying the specified structural guard.

experiments.purpose: Bind all archived Lean overlay sources and the recorded exact statements to the local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports its live Lean invocation count, which may be zero.
